source.title: Staff Selection Commission, Notice: Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (F. No. HQ-C11018/1/2026-C-1, uploaded 21-05-2026)
source.url_note: The file name on the SSC server says 'cgl_2025' but the document is the 2026 notice (header and every date say 2026).
source.pages: PDF p.1 (title, dates at a glance), p.24 (para 13.1-13.7), p.25 (table 13.8, paras 13.8.1-13.8.2), pp.30-31 (para 13.10 Tier-I syllabus), p.41 (paras 16.1, 16.3), p.42 (para 16.10), p.48 (para 23(a))

additional_sources.title: Staff Selection Commission, Important Notice F.No. HQ-EC033/7/2025-EC dated 12.09.2026 (schedule of CGL 2026 Tier-I)

duration_rules.source_ref: table 13.8 (PDF p.25): 1 hour with a sectional timer of 15 minutes for each subject; 1 hour 20 minutes with 15+5=20 minutes per subject for candidates eligible for a scribe (paras 7.1-7.3)

language_rules.paper_is_bilingual: Questions are set in English and Hindi except English Comprehension (para 13.8.1, PDF p.25).
language_rules.prevailing_version: For the notice itself the English version prevails in a dispute (para 23(a), PDF p.48); the notice says nothing about the question paper.

section_navigation_source_ref: Not stated. Table 13.8 gives a 15-minute sectional timer for each subject but not the order of subjects or whether a candidate may move between subjects.

mcq_single.correct_source_ref: derived: 50 maximum marks for 25 questions in each subject (table 13.8, PDF p.25); the notice does not print marks per question for Tier-I
mcq_single.wrong_source_ref: para 13.8.2 (PDF p.25): 'negative marking of 0.50 marks for each wrong answer'

key_anomaly_rules.tentative_key_challenge: Tentative answer keys are placed on the SSC website after the examination; representations are made online within the stated time on payment of Rs 100 per question, non-refundable (para 13.3, PDF p.24).
key_anomaly_rules.guidelines: Guidelines regarding Challenge / Objection Management System, SSC Notice dated 10.04.2026 (para 13.4, PDF p.24); not retrieved.
key_anomaly_rules.re_evaluation: No re-evaluation or re-checking of scores of any stage (para 13.7, PDF p.24).

scoring.normalization: Scores from multiple shifts are normalised by the procedure in the SSC Notice dated 02-06-2025 (para 13.2, PDF p.24).
scoring.merit: Tier-I is for shortlisting only: the final merit list is prepared on Tier-II performance only (para 16.10, PDF p.42).

qualifying.shortlisting: Candidates are shortlisted category-wise for Tier-II on Tier-I marks, with separate cut-offs for JSO and Statistical Investigator Grade-II (Paper-I and Paper-II), for Assistant Audit Officer and Assistant Accounts Officer (Paper-I and Paper-III), and for all other posts (Paper-I) (para 16.3, PDF p.41).

notes: interface 'ssc_tcs' and mode 'cbt': the notice says Computer Based Examination (para 13.1, PDF p.24) but does not name the test vendor or describe the screen, so 'ssc_tcs' is the skill's enum value for SSC CBTs, not a quoted fact.
instructions is null: the notice does not reproduce the instructions screen.
Tier-I is objective multiple-choice (para 13.8.1, PDF p.25).
Marks per question (2) are derived from the table: each subject has 25 questions and 50 maximum marks.
Question level: Parts A, B and D at graduation level, Part C (Quantitative Aptitude) at 10th standard level (para 13.10.5, PDF p.31).
open_questions: The notice is printed in English and Hindi (para 23(a), PDF p.48), but only the English notice was retrieved. Hindi titles here are translations (title_hi_source: translated); replace them with the official Hindi wording.
Normalisation of multi-shift scores follows the SSC procedure published in the Notice dated 02-06-2025 (para 13.2, PDF p.24). That notice was not retrieved, so scoring.normalization only names it.
The notice does not say whether a calculator (on-screen or physical) is allowed. calculator stays null.
Shift timings are not stated in the notice; they appear on the Admission Certificate. shift_timings stays null.
The number of options per question is not stated in the notice. options_per_question stays null.
The order of the four subjects on screen and whether candidates can move between them within the hour are not stated. section_navigation stays null.
